page_title: JUV 4-0 PIS | Juventus v Pisa 07/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Juan Luca Sacchi has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' 4 - 0 It's 4:0! Manuel Locatelli feeds Jeremie Boga (Juventus) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.
90+2' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle and signals a foul after Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) brought his opponent down. Juventus are awarded a free kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team. Juventus have a free kick.

89' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle after Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Pisa win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
87' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
86' Juventus can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
86' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Juventus get a corner.
84' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
82' It's time for a substitution. Filip Kostic (Juventus) comes on in place of Kenan Yildiz.
82' Francesco Coppola (Pisa) commits a rough challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul. Juventus will take a free kick near the side line.
82' Samuel Iling Junior (Pisa) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
79' A pass from Samuel Iling Junior (Pisa) is intercepted by Mattia Perin and the move breaks down.
77' Luciano Spalletti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) replacing Khephren Thuram.
77' Luciano Spalletti has decided to make a change. Fabio Miretti (Juventus) replaces Francisco Conceicao.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Samuel Iling Junior (Pisa) will replace Rafiu Durosinmi.
76' A substitution has been made. Arturo Calabresi goes off and Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa) comes on.
75' 3 - 0 Goal! Francisco Conceicao tees up Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the left side of the goal. 3:0.
73' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
72' Bremer (Juventus) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
72' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Juventus comes to nothing.
71' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
70' Juan Luca Sacchi shows the yellow card to Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) for a heavy challenge.

69' Ambitious effort from Jeremie Boga (Juventus). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.
69' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
68' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) makes a rough challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul. Juventus win a free kick.
68' Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
65' 2 - 0 Goal! Khephren Thuram (Juventus) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
65' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the left post and flies out of play.
65' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
63' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Pisa in a dangerous position.
62' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
60' Substitution. Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris leaves the pitch and is replaced by Juan Cuadrado (Pisa).
60' Oscar Hiljemark has decided to substitute Marius Marin and he is replaced by Felipe Loyola (Pisa).
60' The manager makes a subsitution with Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) coming on for Malthe Hojholt.
58' Malthe Hojholt (Pisa) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Juan Luca Sacchi saw the whole situation. There is a free kick near the sideline to Juventus.

57' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
54' 1 - 0 Goal! Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) makes the score 1:0 after burying a close-range header in the middle of the goal after a good run and cross by Kenan Yildiz.
53' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
52' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
48' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Juventus, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
48' Juan Luca Sacchi shows a yellow card to Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
47' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
46' The game is over for Federico Gatti (Juventus). Lloyd Kelly comes on for the second half.
46' Luciano Spalletti has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Jeremie Boga comes on the pitch for Jonathan David (Juventus).
46' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' A pass from Weston McKennie (Juventus) is intercepted by Nicolas Andrade and the move breaks down.
40' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
40' A yellow card for a tackle by Marius Marin (Pisa). Juan Luca Sacchi doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

39' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
39' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
38' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Juventus.
37' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
37' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
36' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
35' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
32' A pass into the penalty area from Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) is intercepted by the defence.
31' The ball is cleared after Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
30' Samuele Angori (Pisa) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
29' The corner from Michel Aebischer (Pisa) is hurriedly cleared.
28' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Juan Luca Sacchi signals. Pisa are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
27' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
27' Jonathan David (Juventus) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.

26' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.

25' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
24' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
22' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
22' Juventus are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
21' He should have scored! Jonathan David (Juventus) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
20' Samuele Angori (Pisa) swings in a cross from the corner, but Mattia Perin reads it well and gathers the ball.
19' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Pisa earn a corner.
18' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.

17' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Nicolas Andrade, who pulls off a comfortable save!
17' Juventus take a short corner kick.

16' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
15' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
14' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Nicolas Andrade, who smothers the ball.

12' What a chance that is! Khephren Thuram (Juventus) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.
11' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
9' The Juventus players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
7' Rafiu Durosinmi (Pisa) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
5' Samuele Angori (Pisa) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

4' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Pisa have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Juventus will have the kick-off.
Juan Luca Sacchi got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
